headline: MASSIVE COPPER HIT: Power Metallic Intercepts 17.45m @ 9.47% CuEq at Nisk Lion Zone (TSX-V: PNPN)
snippet: Power Metallic Mines (TSX-V: PNPN) released its 2026 winter drill results at the Lion Zone of the Nisk copper-nickel project in Quebec, hitting 17.45 metres at 9.47% copper-equivalent — including a 6.30-metre section at 17.91% CuEq — plus a 39-metre intersection at 5.66% CuEq. The results, dated May 4, advance the company's 2026 Mineral Resource Estimate targeting an upgrade to indicated resource.

headline: GOLD SLIDES 1% as Trump's 'Project Freedom' Ship Rescue Cools Iran Fear Trade
snippet: Gold and silver each fell roughly 1% on May 4 after President Trump announced 'Project Freedom,' an initiative to escort neutral nations' ships safely through the Strait of Hormuz — easing perceived US-Iran conflict risk and draining safe-haven demand. Silver was trading near $76/oz while gold slipped back toward $4,540/oz before stabilising.

headline: DIVIDED FED Kills Gold's Rate-Cut Catalyst; EU Electric Vehicles Quietly Lifting Silver
snippet: Heraeus precious metals analysts say a fractured Federal Reserve — eight members held rates, one pushed for a cut, and three objected to the easing-bias language — has removed gold's primary rate-cut tailwind, with U.S. gold ETF holdings already down 2.1% from February's peak. Silver is finding offsetting industrial demand support from surging European EV sales, even as silver-backed ETF investment weakens.

headline: BIG MONEY Loads Up on Mining Equities as Supercycle Thesis Attracts Billions in Institutional Bets
snippet: Major institutional funds are deploying billions into mining equities betting on a multi-year supercycle driven by electrification, AI infrastructure demand, and critical minerals scarcity — with senior gold miners still trading at just 7-8x EV/EBITDA, well below the 14x multiples of the 2008-2010 boom. Analysts argue the compressed valuation gap implies significant re-rating potential if the supercycle thesis plays out.

headline: COT REPORT May 1: Gold and Silver Speculator Positioning — What the Futures Data Reveals
snippet: The weekly Commitment of Traders report as of May 1, 2026 breaks down speculative and commercial futures positioning in gold, silver, and the U.S. Dollar Index — providing insight into where managed money sits ahead of this week's trading. CFTC positioning data is a closely watched contrarian indicator for near-term momentum shifts in precious metals.

headline: Gold's Safe-Haven Case Is Intact Even as Oil Shocks Rattle Markets, Analysts Argue
snippet: Despite an oil price spike tied to US-Iran tensions roiling broader commodity markets, Kitco analysts argue gold's structural safe-haven fundamentals — central bank demand, geopolitical uncertainty, and de-dollarisation flows — remain firmly intact. The piece makes the case that short-term geopolitical de-escalation can suppress gold temporarily but does not impair the medium-term bull thesis.

headline: BARRICK Advances $60B North American Gold Spinoff, Names Dedicated Executive Team for IPO
snippet: Barrick Mining (NYSE: B) confirmed April 28 it is advancing a year-end IPO for its North American gold assets — Nevada Gold Mines and Pueblo Viejo — which produced roughly 2 million attributable ounces of gold in 2025, with the new entity expected to list in New York and Toronto. A dedicated management team has been appointed, with the spinoff valuation estimated at up to $60 billion.

headline: MINING M&A HITS $21.6B in Strongest Q1 Since 2023 — 121 Deals as Critical Mineral Race Accelerates
snippet: Global mining mergers and acquisitions hit $21.6 billion in Q1 2026, the strongest start to a year since 2023, with White & Case recording 121 transactions — up from 117 in Q1 2025 — as supply-chain security for critical minerals and gold drove dealmaking. Aggregate deal value rose 34% year-over-year, extending momentum from 2025's 13-year-high of $93.7 billion in full-year mining M&A.

headline: CHINA BANS SULPHURIC ACID EXPORTS Effective May, Putting Half of Chile's Copper Output at Risk
snippet: China has halted sulphuric acid exports effective May, removing a critical input for copper leach operations — and Chile, which sourced 37% of its acid from China, faces an immediate supply squeeze. Morgan Stanley warns that up to 1.1 million tonnes of Chilean refined copper production could be at risk, representing more than half the country's refined output, in a market where copper already climbed nearly 40% this year.

headline: CORE LITHIUM Restarts Finniss Open-Pit Mining in May With A$50M NRW Contract, Eyes Q4 Shipment
snippet: Core Lithium (ASX: CXO) has resumed open-pit mining at the Grants deposit within its Finniss Lithium Operation in Australia's Northern Territory — a milestone that sent shares surging more than 11% — with an A$50 million contract awarded to NRW providing access to an estimated 134,000 tonnes of spodumene concentrate. First shipments are targeted for the December quarter of 2026, marking the operation's return from care and maintenance amid recovering spodumene prices.
